name: smwmusic-splatoon-tornado-shuffle
title: Splatoon - Tornado Shuffle
description:
One of the best Splatoon 1 single player songs. Used in levels where you sneak around in your ink to avoid being inkstriked.

Based on the OST version (battle beat vocals but no loud drums).

4/22/2022 Update:
=Updated all vocal samples, and decreased the size of some by a few kb.
-Removed Vocals2_4.brr
=Changed percussion a little bit
=Greatly reduced Channel 7's usage, resulting in less cutoff
+Added third note to synth chords
